build_python_docs: run docgen.py to build gRPC Python documentation using Sphinx in a virtualenv
build_python_docs_with_config: run docgen.py with --config flag to build docs using a specific build configuration
submit_python_docs: run docgen.py with --submit --repo-owner --doc-branch to push generated docs to a GitHub branch
review_subprocess_pipeline: review the subprocess_arguments_list that creates a virtualenv, installs dependencies, and builds docs
review_git_workflow: review the git clone, checkout, commit, and push workflow for submitting documentation to GitHub
